message:
1 classes from the package are invisible to the source scanner:
      PctPhantom (./other, ./widget)
description: `./widget` exports a `PctPhantom` the sources do not declare, under two names, and `./other` re-exports it. It is one class, and the refusal names it once, with each entrypoint it comes from — the package read named the entrypoint under a field the prepared inputs did not have, and a case printed it as `undefined`.
